DowsingRod.name: Staff of Renewal
DowsingRod.text: Forests, fields, rocks and shoals hold more and grow back faster
DowsingRod.story: Renews the land round its Shrine: forests, fields, rocks and shoals there hold {p} more and grow back {p} faster

VerdantSeal.name: Sickle of Plenty
VerdantSeal.text: More out of every swing and every tap
VerdantSeal.story: Blesses every blade and every hand round its Shrine: each swing of a crew and each tap of yours there brings in {p} more

ForemansSigil.name: The Winged Hammer
ForemansSigil.text: Your crews work and your buildings train faster
ForemansSigil.story: Lends wings to every working hand round its Shrine: crews there swing and walk {p} faster, and soldiers and villagers train {p} faster

GildedLedger.name: The Tribute Crown
GildedLedger.story: Reminds every household round its Shrine what it owes the crown: villagers there pay {p} more tax

WanderersCompass.name: The Stargazer’s Orb
WanderersCompass.story: Draws starlight out of the dark: every room you clear in the depths pays {p} more Stardust

spell.name: Survey
spell.text: Clears the fog around a cell you hold, free of gold

DelversLantern.name: The Wisp Lantern
DelversLantern.text: Every room pays more gold and stone
DelversLantern.story: Its wisps find what the dark hides: every room in the depths pays {p} more gold and stone

spell.name: Lamplight
spell.text: The next rooms you clear pay double — cast it before you go down

MusterHorn.name: Warhorn of the Host
MusterHorn.text: Your halls field a bigger army
MusterHorn.story: Its call brings more to your banner: your halls field an army {p} larger

BailiffsTally.name: The Steward’s Signet
BailiffsTally.text: Every improvement you hold pays more an hour
BailiffsTally.story: Your stewards collect what is owed: every district you hold on the world map pays {p} more an hour
